Blueprints

Red cross = anchor (the point that sits on the tile). Dashed blue box = footprint (what blocks movement).
Edit the JSON and the picture updates live. A ● in the list marks a blueprint you changed. Nothing is saved: paste the JSON over its file (src/data/blueprints/paste the JSON over src/data/blueprints/<name>.jsonlt;namepaste the JSON over src/data/blueprints/<name>.jsongt;.json, or src/content/paste the JSON over src/data/blueprints/<name>.jsonlt;namepaste the JSON over src/data/blueprints/<name>.jsongt;.json for buildings), then npm run build.
